records.definition: The Warrior is the part of you that meets danger and moves. It is built to protect what matters and to act when others freeze. In its clean form it is courage with a cause.
records.essence: Protection through force. The will to act under threat.
records.function: Project archetype pattern described by the source entry; functional interpretation remains provisional until the taxonomy's role is verified.
healthyExpression: You hold a line others cannot.
You protect what matters without being asked.
decoherentExpression: It blocks rest. Stillness feels like exposure.
It blocks trust. Everyone is a possible threat.
It blocks softness. Tenderness reads as weakness.
It blocks receiving. You cannot let others carry you.

signals.description: You are calm and decisive while others panic. You take the hit so someone else does not.
You cannot fully stand down. Stillness reads as exposure, so you stay scanning.
Attention triggers the guard. Praise and threat land in the same place.

distortions: It blocks rest. Stillness feels like exposure.
It blocks trust. Everyone is a possible threat.
It blocks softness. Tenderness reads as weakness.
It blocks receiving. You cannot let others carry you.
